fusions.name: Rune-Split Chop
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 13 arcane damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and has a 60% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Candle-Bent Arc
fusions.desc: A glowing swing that deals 4 arcane damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles; each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Spell Impetus] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Mana
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge of Arcana
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
